preregistration.event_rule: Week k (COMPLETE weekly bars of the benchmark, clipped to the data end) is an EVENT iff close[k] > SMA30[k] and close[k-1] < SMA30[k-1]; the streak of consecutive weeks with close < SMA ending at k-1 has length >= 8 (a week with NaN SMA ends the streak); and min(close over the streak) / max(close over weeks k-52..k-1) - 1 <= -0.15. Re-arm is implicit: a new event needs a fresh streak of >= 8 weeks below. Episodes: events less than 26 weeks apart share an id. Mature: k + 156 <= the last benchmark week.
preregistration.verdict_rule: Applied to each of S1, S2, S3, S4 on exit R3, SPY events, the held-out mature events only (2022 and immature events excluded). 'edge' only if ALL of: (1) the event-clustered mean excess vs the date-matched control is > 0 AND the lower bound of its 98.75% interval (Bonferroni over four signatures) is > 0; (2) the signature had trades in >= 5 held-out events AND its per-event excess is > 0 in a strict majority of those events; (3) the survivorship-adjusted excess is > 0 under BOTH the gentle (L=-0.5) and the harsh (L=-1.0, signature missing share x1.5) assumptions. Otherwise 'no demonstrated edge'. A missing input gives 'incomplete (missing: ...)'. B0, the other exits, the horizons, SMH events, 2022 and the placebo never change the verdict.
preregistration.disclosure: The signatures S1-S4 were chosen after looking at the 2022-10-14 .. 2023-02-03 cross-sections of the AI/chip winners (planner fact list). 2022 events are therefore IN-SAMPLE and excluded from the verdict; the 2025 lows were seen in the case-study exploration (not used to pick signatures) and the 2025 event is immature, so it is reported but outside the verdict.
